description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **The idea** — Build a visual "Project Map" view for codx-junior: a UML/sitemap-style canvas where boards/columns appear as draggable blocks connected by lines, with a task list panel that opens on click.

2. **Existing codebase check** — The current app has Kanban, Grid, Column and Files views but zero visual/spatial map view; however the data model (`boards → columns → tasks`, with `parent_id` and `tags`) is already well-suited for it.

3. **Library research** — Searched for Vue 3 / vanilla JS libraries capable of rendering draggable connected nodes: `@vue-flow/core`, `@antv/x6`, `leader-line`, `jsPlumb`, `VueWeave` and others surfaced.

4. **Shortlisting & elimination** — `@antv/x6` discarded (300KB+, overkill, OOP API); `leader-line` discarded (too low-level, no pan/zoom/drag built-in); **`@vue-flow/core` selected** as the winner — Vue 3 native, custom nodes are real Vue components, built-in pan/zoom/drag/minimap, ~35KB gzip, MIT licensed.

5. **Next step** — Implement `KanbanMapView.vue` using `@vue-flow/core`, mapping columns → nodes and connections → edges, embedding existing `TaskCard.vue` inside custom nodes, and wiring it into the existing view switcher in `Kanban.vue`.

## 🗺️ Project Map View — Analysis & Design Proposal

### Does anything like this exist in the codebase?

**No.** The current views are:
- **`KanbanList`** — board cards grid
- **`KanbanGridView`** — flat/grouped task grid with filters
- **`KanbanColumnView`** — classic swim-lane columns
- **`KanbanFilesView`** — file-centric view

There is **zero** visual/spatial/UML-style map view. The data structure (`boards → columns → tasks`, with `parent_id` on boards) is already perfect for this — it just hasn't been visualized spatially.

---

### What you're describing — **"Project Map View"**

Think of it as a hybrid between a **site map**, **mind map**, and **Kanban overview**. Here's the concept:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PROJECT MAP                               [+ Block]     │
│                                                          │
│  ┌──────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────┐           │
│  │ 🔵 Auth Module   │    │ 🟢 Dashboard     │           │
│  │  tags: #login    │───▶│  tags: #ui #data │           │
│  │  3 tasks         │    │  5 tasks         │           │
│  └────────┬─────────┘    └──────────────────┘           │
│           │                                              │
│   ┌───────▼────────┐                                    │
│   │ 🟡 User Profile│                                    │
│   │  tags: #forms  │                                    │
│   │  2 tasks       │                                    │
│   └────────────────┘                                    │
│                                                          │
│         [ Selected: Auth Module ]  ──────▶  Task List   │
│                                        • Fix login bug   │
│                                        • Add OAuth       │
│                                        • Write tests     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### ⚠️ Cons of this view

| Con | Severity | Mitigation |
|:----|:--------:|:-----------|
| **Manual layout** — blocks need X/Y positioning stored per board | Medium | Auto-layout fallback (grid/tree) when no position saved |
| **Data model change** — blocks need `tags`, `x`, `y`, `color`, `connections` stored somewhere | Medium | Extend the existing board's `columns` array or add a `map_nodes` field to the board |
| **No auto-routing** — SVG connection lines between blocks require manual math | Low | Use simple CSS flex tree or dagre-style layout |
| **Mobile unfriendly** — Pan/zoom canvas is awkward on touch | Low | Fallback to list on mobile |
| **Scope creep** — Users may want it to replace their entire PM tool | Low | Keep it as an additional view tab, not default |
| **Performance** — Rendering 100+ blocks + lines + tasks can lag | Low | Virtual/lazy rendering, only render visible area |

---

### ✅ Is it feasible in Vue 3?

**100% yes**, and actually very well-suited because:

1. **The data is already hierarchical** — `board.parent_id`, columns with tasks
2. **`@vueuse/core`** provides drag utilities out of the box
3. **SVG in Vue template** is native — no D3.js needed for connections
4. **CSS `container queries`** already used in this project — responsive blocks are trivial
5. **No external canvas library needed** — pure Vue + SVG + TailwindCSS

---

### 🏗️ Proposed Architecture

Two new components:

#### `KanbanMapView.vue` — The main canvas/map
```
KanbanMapView
├── MapCanvas (pan/zoom container, SVG overlay for connections)
│   ├── MapBlock (per column or board section)
│   │   ├── block header (title, tags, task count)
│   │   ├── connection anchors
│   │   └── [click → emit select-block]
│   └── SVG connections layer
└── TaskPanel (right sidebar - task list for selected block)
    └── TaskCard (existing component, reused)
```

#### Data model extension (stored in board):
```js
// Extend existing board.columns entry with:
{
  id: 'col-uuid',
  title: 'Auth Module',
  // existing fields...
  
  // NEW map fields:
  map: {
    x: 120,          // canvas position
    y: 80,
    color: '#6366f1', // block accent color
    tags: ['#login', '#security'],
    connections: ['col-uuid-2', 'col-uuid-3'], // IDs of connected blocks
    description: 'Handles all authentication flows'
  }
}
```

---

### 🎨 Visual Design Sketch

```
┌──── MAP CANVAS (pan + zoom) ─────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                │
│  [zoom: 100%] [reset] [auto-layout] [+ Block]                 │
│                                                                │
│  ╔══════════════╗         ╔══════════════╗                    │
│  ║ 🔵 Frontend  ║────────▶║ 🟢 API Layer ║                   │
│  ║ ─────────── ║         ║ ─────────── ║                    │
│  ║ #ui #react  ║         ║ #rest #auth  ║                    │
│  ║ 8 tasks     ║         ║ 5 tasks      ║                    │
│  ╚══════╤═══════╝         ╚══════════════╝                    │
│         │                                                      │
│         ▼                                                      │
│  ╔══════════════╗                                             │
│  ║ 🟡 Auth Page ║  ← selected (highlighted)                  │
│  ║ ─────────── ║                                             │
│  ║ #login #sso ║                                             │
│  ║ 3 tasks     ║                                             │
│  ╚══════════════╝                                             │
│                                                                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          ↓ (right panel appears on block click)
┌── TASK LIST PANEL ───────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Auth Page  ·  3 tasks              [+ New Task]  [✕ Close]  │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│  ● Fix OAuth redirect bug          [chat]  2h ago            │
│  ● Add remember-me checkbox        [task]  yesterday         │
│  ● Write login unit tests          [task]  3d ago            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 🛠️ Shall I build it?

I can implement `KanbanMapView.vue` as a **new view tab** (next to Board/Files in `Kanban.vue`) with:

- [x] Drag-to-reposition blocks on canvas
- [x] Click block → task list slides in from right
- [x] SVG connection lines between blocks (defined per column)
- [x] Tags/keywords on each block (stored in column's `map.tags`)
- [x] Pan + zoom with mouse wheel
- [x] Auto-layout button (grid fallback when no positions saved)
- [x] "New Task" quick-add from within the map panel
- [x] Reuse existing `TaskCard` component
- [x] Responsive: collapses to list on mobile
- [x] Integrates into `Kanban.vue`'s view switcher

**Just say "build it"** and I'll generate the full implementation! Or let me know if you want to adjust the design first (e.g., tree-only layout, no SVG lines, board-level vs column-level blocks, etc.).

# Welcome to Vue Flow! [​](https://vueflow.dev/guide/#welcome-to-vue-flow)

Vue Flow is a bridge to the world of interactive flowcharts and graphs, empowering you to bring dynamism and interactivity to flowcharts and graphic representations. Whether it's crafting personal diagrams, generating dynamic editors, or anything else your imagination conjures up, Vue Flow is your creative companion.

Vue Flow makes it effortless to customize and extend basic functionalities by allowing the integration of your own bespoke nodes and edges. Additional components such as Background, Minimap, and Controls further enrich the interface, transforming your creations into engaging platforms.

###  Customizable [​](https://vueflow.dev/guide/#customizable)

Vue Flow is yours to shape. From custom nodes and edges to connection lines, you can extend the functionality of Vue Flow to fit your creative needs.
